portal_hypertension.title: Management of hepatopulmonary syndrome and portopulmonary hypertension.
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：门脉肺动脉高压（PoPH）和肝肺综合征（HPS）是两种肺血管疾病，发生在肝脏疾病的背景下，发病率和死亡率很高。 临床提示：尽管 PoPH 的机制仍不清楚，但最近的工作已确定 9 型骨形态发生蛋白的缺乏是可能驱动 HPS 肺血管重塑的关键特征。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Portopulmonary hypertension (PoPH) and hepatopulmonary syndrome (HPS) are two pulmonary vascular diseases, that occur in the context of liver disease, with high morbidity and mortality. The mechanistic link between liver and lung that drives disease pathogenesis in these conditions is not well understood, and although liver transplantation offers benefit for both PoPH and HPS, posttransplant consequences can be severe and result in critical illness. Though the mechanisms of PoPH are still obscure, recent work has identified a deficiency of bone morphogenetic protein type 9 as a key characteristic that may drive pulmonary vascular remodeling in HPS.
